fields.department: of Education, have officially declared the results for the Teaching and Non-Teaching Recruitment 2025 (Advt. 01/2025). This massive recruitment drive aimed to fill over 10,000 vacancies across various categories including Principal, Vice-Principal, PGT, TGT, Librarian, and several administrative roles. fields.vacancyDetails: (Consolidated) A total of 10,000+ vacancies were notified under Advertisement 01/2025. The results declared on March 1st cover the following cadres: Post Category Major Positions Approx Vacancies Teaching Group A Principal, Vice Principal 500+ Teaching Group B PGT, TGT, PRT (Music), Librarian 7,500+ Non-Teaching Group B ASO, Section Officer, Finance Officer 400+ Non-Teaching Group C Stenographer, SSA, JSA, LDC 1,600+ 6. Educational Qualification (Criteria Met) Candidates qualified for the written exam results based on the following minimum essential qualifications: Principal: Master's Degree + B.Ed + 15 Years of relevant experience. PGT: Master's Degree in concerned subject with 50% marks + B.Ed. TGT: Bachelor's Degree in concerned subject with 50% marks + B.Ed + CTET Paper-II. Librarian: Degree/Diploma in Library Science. JSA: Class 12th pass with proficiency in Computer Typing (35 wpm Eng / 30 wpm Hindi). 7. Mode of Selection (Detailed Stages) The selection process for Advt. 01/2025 follows a rigorous screening mechanism: Stage 1: Written Examination (CBT): The result declared on March 1, 2026, is for the 150-180 mark objective test. This stage determines the shortlisting for the next phase. Stage 2: Interview/Demo (Teaching): Candidates shortlisted from CBT (usually in a 1:3 ratio) will undergo an interview. For PGT/TGT, a Demo Teaching session is mandatory. Stage 3: Skill Test (Non-Teaching): Posts like Stenographer and JSA require a qualifying Shorthand/Typing test. This does not carry merit marks but is essential to pass. Final Merit Preparation: Teaching Posts: Fina
